final_message:
The change will fail.

It only addresses the manufacturer endpoint, and even there it merely preserves an existing `ResourceNotFoundException` instead of converting other missing-item behavior. The `/api/v2/product/{sku}` endpoint is untouched, so nonexistent SKUs will still return 400 rather than 404.

The `RestErrorHandler` change also alters the error payload’s localized message behavior unnecessarily and may break existing tests expecting `exception.getLocalizedMessage()`.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 99
